name: Solomon
source:
He was friends with devils and was a great king and summoner who was known to be the only neutral creature who was a colleague of God.

The only being who was loved by humans, by devils, and even by God.

It is said that everyone in Hell, from the tiny insect devils to the Seven Deadly Sins, loved and liked him.

Even now, after 3000 years, you can see devils talking and laughing about the day Solomon visited, even in a small pub in a corner of Hell.

All devils believe he will return one day to let them hear his hearty laughter and bet on the most extraordinary things again.
